name: Osirus
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Access Virus A, B and C synthesizers' original firmware (gearmulator's DSP56300 emulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and patch browser, Q-Link control and knob values on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Virus ROM.
